title: From structure to community place
subtitle: Drive the first composition from an accepted architectural capsule into a Guild venue, creator campaign, live Runtime experience, and community evidence loop.

proof_boundary.proof_level: installed-proven architectural substrate; implemented/simulated campaign substrate
accepted: The immutable tn0304 capsule and its architectural interpretation are accepted inputs.
The canonical 40-piece adaptation is staged and has returned an exact live MATCH.
The retained AM4 build can be reopened through the bounded read-only demo path.
Guild v2 can promote a typed Signature Hunt abstraction and create two campaign artifacts.
Runtime continuation and the one-operation campaign start are implemented and simulated with exact identity correlation.
not_claimed: The architectural build is not yet a Guild palette primitive.
The campaign is not yet bound to the structure as a venue.
No installed player lap has proved the two hunts, successor transition, campaign completion, or community evidence return.
The workbook is a decision and evidence surface; its checkmarks are never machine proof.

stages.title: Accepted architectural substrate
stages.summary: Baseline intent, Studio interpretation, canonical Lab pair, exact live placement, MATCH, rollback, and warm reuse are pinned.

stages.title: Promote the build as a Guild venue
stages.summary: A steward publishes the accepted build lineage, lifecycle, evidence policy, and bounded creator freedoms as one typed palette primitive.

stages.title: Compose Signature Hunt at the venue
stages.summary: The two-artifact campaign substrate exists. The open seam is making the venue an owned part of that creative composition instead of an adjacent artifact.

stages.title: Activate one exact composition
stages.summary: One bounded operation must place or reuse the exact venue, bind the campaign entry anchor, activate the exact revision, and retain cleanup authority.

stages.title: Return player evidence to the community system
stages.summary: Installed completion evidence must trace from player run through campaign and creator artifact back to the steward-published venue primitive and capsule.

screenshots.title: The accepted architectural reading
screenshots.caption: Studio presents source-backed dimensions, reconciliations, provenance, and game-only adaptations without changing the source observation.

screenshots.title: The canonical game adaptation
screenshots.caption: Forty exact pieces are the accepted substrate. The next decision is what this object means and who may configure which aspects of it.

screenshots.title: The structure standing in Valheim
screenshots.caption: This is accepted operational evidence, not yet a community place. The composition slice gives it steward meaning, creator use, Runtime behavior, and evidence lineage.

actions.title: Orient to the composition, not the machinery
actions.prompt: Read the proof boundary and connection map. Record only if the proposed composition is solving the wrong creator-level problem.
actions.precondition: The tracked workbook manifest and accepted evidence links load.

actions.title: Name what this place means
actions.prompt: Is The Slayers' Field Lodge the right community meaning? Describe the role this place plays for stewards, creators, and players.
actions.precondition: The accepted structure is treated as a substrate, not an unresolved building test.

actions.title: Draw the steward boundary
actions.prompt: Record what the steward must lock: source lineage, structural identity, lifecycle, evidence policy, allowed campaigns, or other invariants.
actions.precondition: The venue has a stated community meaning.

actions.title: Draw the creator boundary
actions.prompt: Record what creators may configure: name, story copy, placement intent, anchor choice, attached experiences, or a deliberately smaller set.

actions.title: Make Signature Hunt inhabit the venue
actions.prompt: Describe how Air Drop starts here, how Cold Shot succeeds it, what object or area anchors entry, and what completion means to the community.
actions.precondition: Creator freedoms are bounded enough to compile deterministically.

actions.title: Attack the composition seams
actions.prompt: Look for the first place ownership, versioning, placement, binding, cleanup, or evidence lineage becomes ambiguous. Mark every ‘can't answer why’ moment.
actions.precondition: The venue and campaign have one concrete proposed relationship.

actions.title: Judge the one-operation demo
actions.prompt: Would a bounded venue → campaign → play → evidence demonstration prove the creative abstraction is real? Record what would make the demo convincing or theatrical.
actions.precondition: The open seams are visible and machine facts remain separate from human judgment.

actions.title: Choose the next machine-owned attack
actions.prompt: Select the verdict and next attack, preserve exact observations, then export the review packet for triage.
actions.precondition: The semantic, authority, composition, and demo judgments have all been considered.

commands.label: Open the accepted demo
commands.detail: Runs the already-proven warm status/check/count/diff/status path, then opens Studio and the exact Valheim capture.

commands.label: Read demo status
commands.detail: Reads the bounded control-plane and warm-session status without changing the world.

commands.label: Stop Studio only
commands.detail: Stops only the Studio host and SSH tunnel. The warm Valheim structure remains standing.

commands.label: Explicitly close and restore
commands.detail: Stops the retained client and restores the exact pre-session plugin, Runtime, Lab, world, and character bytes.

limitations: The workbook can copy commands but cannot execute them.
Browser checkmarks and notes are observations, not receipts or acceptance evidence.
The accepted warm state can drift outside the workbook; use the bounded status surface before any demo.
Exported review JSON is untrusted input and requires triage before it changes repository or product state.
